data.explanation: This is an invoice from a painting company for work done in your home. You should pay the total amount to the IBAN given by the deadline shown (the app calculates it from the date you received this invoice), quoting the invoice number as reference if possible. If you do not pay, the company may send reminders or pursue the debt further, though no penalty is stated here. Keep this invoice: labour costs for craftsman services (Handwerkerleistungen) can often be deducted from your German tax return, so it may be worth mentioning to a tax advisor or including in your tax software.
